messages:
Samira (product): FYI VendorX reported 401s hitting Dedicated instances after a token rotation. Support says ~3 customers affected, VendorX is P1. Need decision: hotfix vs next weekly release, plus canary plan and comms. @Kevin @Maya

Ash (support): Repro steps: POST /v1/infer with header X-Client-Version: 2.1. After rotation requests return 'token invalid'. Started ~03:12 UTC. Affected pool: d-42 (Dedicated).

Kevin (eng): Sounds like a config-load race where auth cache can drop keys during rotation. Small patch to add fallback to KMS on cache miss. Patch requires restarting a subset of pods to pick up new runtime flags. Rough estimate: 2-3h including canary and monitoring.

Maya (eng-sre): We can run a progressive canary on d-42: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Canary steps 30m each, monitor error rate and latency. Rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-runtime -n dedicated --to-revision=prev`. Need on-call coverage.

Julian (solutions): VendorX expects an immediate fix and explicit ETA. They asked whether we will do a silent patch or schedule maintenance. Also asked to confirm no data loss.

Samira (product): Proposal: Hotfix tonight at 22:00 UTC (off-peak for VendorX). Do progressive canary on d-42, notify vendor + CSM before start. If canary passes, roll to all Dedicated pools over 2 hours; if fail, rollback and send immediate update. Agree?

Kevin (eng): +1. I'll open a PR `hotfix/vendorx-auth` and run focused auth smoke tests (run `scripts/smoke_auth.sh`). Minimal risk but we skip full release QA — we'll keep the scope tiny.

Ash (support): I'll draft the vendor notice and loop in CSM. Draft will include brief impact summary, ETA, expected blip during restarts, and promise of a post-mortem. Will post for review in 30m.

Maya (eng-sre): Confirmed 22:00 UTC works for on-call. I'll create the canary job with `traffic_percent` steps and 30m hold each. I'll also add alert thresholds: auth_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m triggers rollback.

deploy-bot: Deployment created: canary/hotfix/vendorx-auth at 1943217900. Canary automation will execute 5% -> 25% -> 100% if checks pass.

Samira (product): Action items: Kevin PR + tests, Maya run canary/monitoring, Ash vendor comms + CSM, Julian confirm no billing impact. I'll tag backlog item `customer-hotfix` and schedule postmortem. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Julian (solutions): Confirmed no billing impact. I'll coordinate test tokens with VendorX and validate live traffic during canary.
